integrity.proof_basis: Exact character orthogonality followed by sharp finite-dimensional inequalities; finite computation is corroborative only.
integrity.residual_literature_risk: An equivalent one-collision optimization could exist in older Lambda(4), B_2[g], or finite Fourier-restriction literature under different notation.

scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes odd group order and exactly one two-representation fiber of the unordered pair-sum map.
It does not treat interacting multiple collisions or the extra diagonal phenomena possible in even-order groups.
It does not classify all sets having the one-defect additive structure.
title: Sharp fourth-extension constants for a single pair-sum defect
